mapper.select: SELECT permission_code FROM admin_permission WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND active_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY permission_code

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.email, u.nickname, u.account_status AS accountStatus, u.last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, u.created_at AS createdAt, COALESCE( JSON_ARRAYAGG( CASE WHEN ap.active_yn = 'Y' THEN ap.permission_code ELSE NULL END ), JSON_ARRAY() ) AS permissions FROM user_account u LEFT JOIN admin_permission ap ON ap.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.account_type = 'ADMIN' GROUP BY u.user_id, u.email, u.nickname, u.account_status, u.last_login_at, u.created_at ORDER BY u.user_id

SELECT u.user_id AS userId, u.email, u.nickname, u.account_status AS accountStatus, u.last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, u.created_at AS createdAt, COALESCE( JSON_ARRAYAGG( CASE WHEN ap.active_yn = 'Y' THEN ap.permission_code ELSE NULL END ), JSON_ARRAY() ) AS permissions FROM user_account u LEFT JOIN admin_permission ap ON ap.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.account_type = 'ADMIN' AND u.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY u.user_id, u.email, u.nickname, u.account_status, u.last_login_at, u.created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_permission (user_id, permission_code, active_yn, granted_by, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{permissionCode}, #{activeYn}, #{grantedBy}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE active_yn = VALUES(active_yn), granted_by = VALUES(granted_by)
